meta.query: Which drugs frequently co-occur in combination studies for lung cancer?
meta.interpretation: Build a drug co-occurrence network showing which drugs are tested together in the same lung cancer trials.
assumptions: Combination studies are interpreted as trials listing multiple drugs, so no extra filter was applied.
No year, phase, or status restrictions were applied.
14,625 trials match but only the 2,000 most recently started were fetched; values are computed from that sample.
594 of 2,000 fetched trials contained at least one linked pair.
